seo.description: Free Disney Lorcana Winterspell checklist: all 243 cards and every foil, with images, prices and binder pages. No ads, no sign-up, no tracking.
seo.ogDescription: Track all 243 cards in Disney Lorcana Winterspell: the 204-card main set, 18 Epic, 18 Enchanted, 2 Iconic and 1 Illumineer’s Quest cards, plus 204 foils. Free, with no ads, no sign-up and no tracking.
seo.twitterDescription: Track all 243 cards in Disney Lorcana Winterspell. Free, with no ads, no sign-up and no tracking.

about.title: About the Winterspell set
paragraphs: Winterspell is the 11th Disney Lorcana booster set, released on 20 February 2026. It has 243 cards: 204 in the main set, 18 Epic, 18 Enchanted, 2 Iconic and 1 Illumineer’s Quest cards. There are also 204 foils, one for each main set card.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 204 main set cards), the Master set (408 cards, adding the foils) or the Grand Master set (all 447 cards, adding the Epic, Enchanted, Iconic and Illumineer’s Quest cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
